name: Chameleon
desc: A color-field chameleon whose skin literally is the hue param — it rocks like a leaf on its branch, swivels a turret eye, curls its spiral tail, pumps its throat, and snaps a ballistic tongue at a hovering fly on the bass.

energy.doc: motion amplitude: rock sway, throat pump, tail curl

hue.doc: LITERAL skin hue (drifts slowly around this)

pose.doc: perch=idle rock+grip, stalk=creeping rock-walk, display=puffed throat + flushed warning colors

style.doc: aesthetic: soft luminous color-field mass w/ no outline (Rothko-ish) / oil-slick iridescent hue-shift scales / pointillist stippled scales (engraving) / anatomical X-ray glowing skeleton (abstract) / schematic blueprint contour lines (abstract)

act.doc: multi-minute skin dramaturgy: bask lazy hue-wander, hunt steady stalking creep, threat flush toward hot warning colors
